title: Agent chat: render assistant messages as Markdown (safe, themed, streaming-friendly)
description: USER FEATURE: agent chat messages should render Markdown. Today AgentChatPanel renders assistant message text as plain text nodes (packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/AgentChatPanel.tsx). Render assistant/agent message bodies as Markdown. REQUIREMENTS: (1) Use react-markdown + remark-gfm (GFM: tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolinks) — add as deps to packages/authoring-ui. SAFE by default: do NOT enable rehype-raw / raw HTML passthrough, so assistant text cannot inject HTML (preserve the no-XSS property the audit noted). (2) Render: headings, bold/italic, ordered/unordered lists, inline code, fenced code blocks (monospace, light-gray inset background, horizontal scroll for long lines), blockquotes, links (open in new tab, rel='noopener noreferrer'), tables (GFM). Style all elements to fit the Flash 8 LIGHT theme via the flash8Theme tokens (near-black text on light bg; code blocks use chrome.insetFieldStrip-ish bg + monospace). (3) Keep message text SELECTABLE (don't regress task 1285 — markdown container stays user-select:text). (4) STREAMING-friendly: assistant text streams in deltas; react-markdown must re-render on each update and degrade gracefully on partial/incomplete markdown (no crash on an unclosed code fence mid-stream). (5) Scope: render ASSISTANT messages as markdown; user's own typed messages can stay plain text (or markdown — your call, keep simple). Tool-call chips keep their current arg/result formatting (code-ish), unchanged. VERIFY ground truth first (how messages render now). TEST: unit test that a markdown string (bold + list + fenced code + link + table) renders the expected elements (and that no raw-HTML injection renders as HTML). Build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); the agent-chat e2e oracle still passes. Update docs/32-agent-chat.md (note markdown rendering). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file + package.json/lockfile; push rebase-retry. Scope: AgentChatPanel.tsx (+ maybe a small Markdown component), package.json, docs/32.
